content: Redis (redis.io docs + SO): async master-replica replication; PSYNC partial resync after brief disconnects via replication backlog (repl-backlog-size default 1MB) and PSYNC2 secondary replid across restarts, else full resync ships an RDB snapshot (diskless option); persistence via RDB snapshots + AOF with rewrite; replicas read-only by default; WAIT numreplicas timeout blocks until N replicas ack prior writes (best-effort, not strict); Sentinel monitors and fails over masters, reconfigures clients; split-brain risk during partitions - old master can accept writes that are later lost.
